Ad creatives · Video scripts

Ad scripts for From Calling to Craft

Three talking-to-camera scripts, about 30 to 45 seconds each.

Script 1 · “Calling vs craft”

Hook (0 to 3s)

“Loving coaching and being great at it are two different things.”

Body

“Most coaches start with a calling. You care, you listen, you want to help. But the coaches clients never forget have something else: a craft. A structure for every session, the right questions, and tools they trust. And a craft can be learned.”

CTA

“I’m teaching it in a free live class called From Calling to Craft. Tap Sign up to save your seat.”

Shot: talking to camera with your handheld mic, same setup as your recent reels.

Script 2 · “The one question”

Hook (0 to 3s)

“One question can change the whole session.”

Body

“Good coaches ask good questions. Great coaches ask the right one at the right moment, and then they stay quiet. That’s usually when the breakthrough happens. In my free class I’ll show you how I structure a session so that moment has room to happen.”

CTA

“From Calling to Craft. Free, live, replay included. Tap Sign up.”

Shot: close-up to camera, on-screen text “the right question” in gold.

Script 3 · “A craft you can stand behind”

Hook (0 to 3s)

“If you’ve taken course after course, this one’s for you.”

Body

“Collecting tools isn’t the same as knowing how they fit together. NLP, EFT, hypnosis, the T.I.M.E. Technique. In this free class I’ll show you where each one belongs in a session, so you can coach with confidence.”

CTA

“Save your free seat for From Calling to Craft. Tap Sign up below.”

Shot: talking to camera, cut to a slide listing the four tools.
